g.title: None.None.Node.1
g.text: Azure hybrid network with ExpressRoute, VPN backup, Azure Firewall and DNS Private Resolver

g.title: None.None.Node.23
g.text: The workstation's traffic for 10.1.0.0/16 goes to the edge routers, which learned it over BGP
The routers send it over the ExpressRoute circuit's private peering
to the ExpressRoute gateway in the hub
The gateway route table sends spoke traffic through Azure Firewall
The firewall policy allows it to the internal load balancer in the peered spoke
which balances it across ERP VMs in two availability zones
The VMs use SQL Managed Instance in a delegated subnet
The data centre DNS servers forward Azure private zones to the resolver's inbound endpoint
The DNS Private Resolver answers from the linked private DNS zones
If the circuit fails, BGP moves traffic to the site-to-site VPN
which takes the same path through the firewall
Administrators reach the VMs only through Azure Bastion
